name: Japan National Women's Junior Championship
notes: Decided by a single match between Keiko Sakura and DARIA Wakizawa at Virgin's Brawl.
epitaph: A junior women's title of the JIWWA, decided at Virgin's Brawl on 15 December 2001, where Keiko Sakura beat DARIA Wakizawa for it in 21 minutes 46 seconds. One reign is recorded.
